title: Skill run (one file in _runs/)
description: A run is an order: a skill, a container, who asked. The cockpit writes it; a runner picks it up, executes the skill in a headless agent session, and writes the outcome back into the same file. The pipeline root is the queue — a runner that is off leaves the order waiting. Status moves queued → running → done | failed and never back.

skill.description: The skill to run, as the person would type it after the slash. The list is what this pipeline offers as a button.

container.description: stage/name of the piece the skill works on.

note.description: What the person wants beyond the skill's default — handed to the session verbatim.

requested_by.description: The signed-in person who pressed the button.

runner.description: Which kind of runner may take it: claude-code runs the real skill in a headless Claude Code session on the person's own machine and subscription; api is a model behind a key or an on-premise endpoint (not built yet).

taken_by.description: The runner instance that claimed it, e.g. chris@Mac.

session.description: The agent session the run happened in — the thread a later run may continue.

log.description: Path of the run's transcript, relative to the pipeline root.

result.description: The session's closing words, as the runner saw them.
